title: ChatContact/queryChanges missing from peer-rejection test matrix
description: integration.rs:527-560: test_peer_cannot_call_owner_methods enumerates 13 owner methods but omits ChatContact/queryChanges. If the role gate for that method were accidentally removed, this dispatcher-level test would not catch it. Coverage exists at the e2e layer but the dispatch-layer test should be exhaustive. Add ChatContact/queryChanges to the list.
